purpose: Reassemble all usable active discharge observations before refitting MAP and recursive assimilation.
training_eligibility: at least 60 usable months in 2006-2018 spanning at least 4 calendar years
checking_eligibility: training eligible plus at least 18 usable months in 2019-2022 spanning at least 2 calendar years
same_reach_rule: one representative station per Reach; among training-eligible stations prefer ordinary river gauges and the most downstream location on the Reach, then greater coverage and shorter snap distance
assimilation_contract: one-step prediction; month t observation may update only t+1 and later; no observation updates after 2018-12
q72_role: physical reference and mass-balance audit, not one of the four primary result groups
